# Timlee

> Website where signed-in, allowlisted users describe an app and the GitHub
> Copilot CLI builds it as a Svelte app in a shared design system. Go
> server-rendered site, separate auth service, Tauri desktop shell.

## Start here

- [Repository README](README.md)
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md)
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md)
- [Status](docs/STATUS.md)

## Architecture

- `cmd/timlee-web`: website (landing, sign-in, settings, apps workspace, preview server); `server.go` routes, `apps.go`, `preview.go`
- `cmd/timlee-auth` + `internal/authsvc` + `internal/store`: sessions, OAuth, orgs, API keys, prompt allowlist, SQLite
- `cmd/timlee-dev` + `internal/devstack`: local orchestrator
- `cmd/timlee-build` + `internal/assets`: asset pipeline and manifest
- `internal/render`, `web/templates`: server rendering
- `web/components`: light-DOM Web Components; `web/assets`: CSS/TS entry points
- `web/locales`, `internal/i18n`: ARB catalogs and locale routing
- `internal/appfactory`: creates apps, runs the Copilot CLI per prompt, enforces the app boundary, builds with Bazel, publishes previews, commits to the workspace repo
- `desktop`: Tauri 2 shell
- `workspace`: Bazel monorepo of generated apps (its own git repo; `workspace/AGENTS.md` are the rules Copilot follows)

## Development

```sh
go run ./cmd/timlee-dev        # web :5173, auth :8788, both on 127.0.0.1
go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...
corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test
```

## Constraints

- Prompts only from accounts on `TIMLEE_ALLOWED_EMAILS` (empty = nobody).
- Pages must work without JavaScript; components stay in light DOM.
- English only; pseudo-locales are test-only.
- No repository-wide license has been declared.
